payees_verified_has_method.name: payees_verified_has_method
payees_verified_has_method.value: "payees"."status" <> 'verified' or ("payees"."verification_method" is not null and "payees"."verified_at" is not null)

vendor_clients_identifier.name: vendor_clients_identifier
vendor_clients_identifier.value: "vendor_clients"."vault" is not null or "vendor_clients"."email" is not null

vendor_invitations_single_terminal_state.name: vendor_invitations_single_terminal_state
vendor_invitations_single_terminal_state.value: not ("vendor_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "vendor_invitations"."revoked_at" is not null)

vendor_verifications_second_is_distinct.name: vendor_verifications_second_is_distinct
vendor_verifications_second_is_distinct.value: "vendor_verifications"."second_by" is null or ("vendor_verifications"."second_by" <> "vendor_verifications"."raised_by" and ("vendor_verifications"."confirmed_by" is null or "vendor_verifications"."second_by" <> "vendor_verifications"."confirmed_by"))

vendor_verifications_code_fields.name: vendor_verifications_code_fields
vendor_verifications_code_fields.value: "vendor_verifications"."method" <> 'code' or ("vendor_verifications"."code_hmac" is not null and "vendor_verifications"."code_ciphertext" is not null and "vendor_verifications"."expires_at" is not null and "vendor_verifications"."seal" is not null)
